headline: Ozod Axunov appointed chairman of "Thermal Power Plants"
summary: Ozod Axunov has been appointed chairman of the board of the Thermal Power Plants joint-stock company. He previously served as the company's first deputy.
why: Thermal power plants supply electricity in Uzbekistan, so leadership changes at state energy producers can matter for the country's power sector.
original_headline: Ozod Axunov “Issiqlik elektr stansiyalari” raisi etib tayinlandi
